pageIdentity.owner: python/atlas_doc_coordinate.py DocCoordinateV1 (page/version); built natively by atlas_okf_docs_pipeline.build_page_coordinate from manifest fields
pageIdentity.formula: DocCoordinateV1.evidence_revision = sha256(stable-json{provider,product,product_version,url,section_anchor,content_hash}); constructed ONCE per page and carried unchanged into every chunk
pageIdentity.contentHashBasis: sha256 of _normalize_ws(page text) - the same normalized text the chunk byte spans address (23 of 30 stored pages differ from that text because chunk_document re-normalizes code indentation; follow-up gate EXTERNAL_DOC_CHUNK_TEXT_INDENTATION_FIDELITY)
pageIdentity.versionQualificationRule: exact versions only for EXACT_VERSION/MAJOR_VERSION manifest sources; live pages are CURRENT_UPSTREAM@<capture date>; issue pages UNVERSIONED@<capture date>

chunkIdentity.owner: python/atlas_doc_coordinate.py ExternalDocChunkEvidenceV1 / chunk_evidence_revision; TS mirror sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/server/atlas/docs/external-doc-intelligence-contracts-v1.ts chunkEvidenceRevisionV1
chunkIdentity.formula: sha256:canonicalSha256V1{schema:"atlas.external-doc-chunk-evidence.v1", pageEvidenceRevision, ordinal, startByte, endByte, chunkChecksum} (ATLAS_CANONICAL_V1; Python port asserts key/format parity; golden value asserted in both languages; not truncated)

corpus.countNote: count is measured, not hard-coded; unchanged at 847 after the identity repair (chunking itself was not modified)

before.note: old chunk coordinate = page coordinate with section_anchor rewritten to the heading path and content_hash rebound; chunks sharing a heading shared one revision

invariants: A same page + same heading + multiple chunks -> unique chunkEvidenceRevision per span (python + fixture)
C identical chunk text at different byte locations -> different revisions (python)
D changed chunk bytes / E changed start/end byte / F changed page revision -> different revisions (python parametrized + TS)
G different product version -> different page revision and disjoint child chunk revisions (python)
H UTF-8 / non-ASCII spans replay identically and slice exact bytes (python + committed cross-language fixture)
chunkId is unchanged and never equal to chunkEvidenceRevision
a page evidence revision is never sent as a chunk evidence revision (TS validator blocker)
Python golden revision equals TypeScript canonicalSha256V1 result

doc06aMapping.page.contentHash: DocCoordinateV1.content_hash (sha256 of the normalized text the spans address)

cacheIdentityReadiness.warming: ACE/BitFrost/Valkey per-chunk derived-analysis warming stays BLOCKED until canonical chunks are admitted; no cache was written

analysisOwnerAudit.atlas_summary_layers: packet_key keyed and upserted (updated_at), not append-only - not reusable
